title: Rate Worksheet Note — Ceiling Fee and Floor at an Independent Living Annual Increase
content:
This worksheet note governs which fee is recorded when an annual increase of the Independent Living Residency Agreement monthly service fee takes effect, by comparing the fee in the written notice with the ceiling fee and with the fee in effect before.

## Definitions

- **Fee in effect immediately before the increase** — the amount of the latest full-month base fee charge on the residency ledger (the most recently posted base fee charge billed for a whole calendar month).
- **Ceiling fee** — the fee in effect immediately before the increase raised by the increase ceiling percentage, rounded once to the cent half up. The increase ceiling percentage is the contract ceiling percentage of the resident's contract after the percentage-point reductions subtracted from it.
- **Noticed fee** — the fee stated in the written notice of the increase mailed to the resident.

## Rule

| Comparison | Fee recorded |
|---|---|
| The noticed fee exceeds the ceiling fee | The ceiling fee, in place of the noticed fee |
| The noticed fee is lower than the fee in effect immediately before the increase | The fee in effect immediately before the increase, unchanged — an annual increase never lowers the fee |
| Otherwise | The noticed fee, as stated |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Latest full-month base fee charge 4,000.00; increase ceiling percentage 6.75.

The ceiling fee is 4,000.00 raised by 6.75 percent: 4,000.00 multiplied by 1.0675 is 4,270.00.

| Noticed fee | Fee recorded | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 4,350.00 | 4,270.00 | Above the ceiling fee |
| 4,270.00 | 4,270.00 | Equal to the ceiling fee, not above it |
| 4,180.00 | 4,180.00 | Between the fee before and the ceiling fee |
| 3,950.00 | 4,000.00 | Below the fee in effect before |

With a fee before of 3,968.00 and an increase ceiling percentage of 5.75, the ceiling fee is 3,968.00 multiplied by 1.0575, that is 4,196.16; a noticed fee of 4,250.00 is recorded at 4,196.16.
